mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy shift that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS decline periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in GDP and housing starts (GDPC1 and HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand and confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 and HOUST expansion fails to produce positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the correlation between the joint signal and returns is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation cycle, a monthly increase in CPIAUCSL exceeding 0.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in a high inflation cycle.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in PAYEMS growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 90.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 90.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand and economic confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS expansion fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the correlation between the joint signal and returns is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained level of industrial production above 95.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in INDPRO expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
